summary: Master GIPS 2020 standards for investment performance. Learn composite construction, verification, and reporting from industry experts. Enroll today.
lede: GIPS standards provide a framework for investment performance reporting, including return calculation, composite construction and disclosure. This course is for investment performance, compliance, portfolio and audit professionals who prepare or assess performance records and reports. It covers time-weighted and Modified Dietz returns, composite maintenance, pooled fund and asset-owner reporting, record controls, error correction and verification preparation.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the integrity, calculation, and reporting of investment performance data within institutional and retail environments.
modules: GIPS Compliance Roadmap and Institutional Reporting Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of investment performance measurement concepts, including basic return calculations and portfolio accounting. Familiarity with the CFA Institute Code of Ethics and professional standards is recommended. No prior experience with GIPS compliance is required, though a working knowledge of Excel for financial analysis is essential for the calculation workshops.
